prioritized_corrections.correction: Make the swing-toe interruption and continuing forward momentum unmistakable without labels, tighten the reacting catch timing, and remove the decorative pre-catch rise. Preserve heel arrival followed by load compression.

prioritized_corrections.issue: Girl still shares boy's main landing/compression beat40-44; the later wait reads as a near-static upright pose while boy slowly rises.

prioritized_corrections.issue: Restart/walk is less crouched, but the upright trunk and regular pendular limbs still read mechanically. Small proxy-foot/ankle separation also weakens visible contact, so plate lock alone does not sell load.
prioritized_corrections.correction: Refine push-off, pelvis rise/fall and head/chest overlap together, then rejudge at speed and shot size. Keep independent contact clocks; do not try to solve weight by repainting.

retained_gain: Keep the independent root/foot foundation and the landing->compression->front-support recovery ordering; revise timing/acting within this unpainted test.
